digest.component_or_area: reconciler field contract and property tests
propositions: Reconciler parity bugs escape because per-field asymmetry policy is scattered across multiple code sites with no single declarative source; a field contract registry is needed to enumerate each reconciled field with its symmetry class.
The registry must declare bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, and one-way-with-propagation-gate symmetry classes for 11 reconciled fields, referencing their corresponding codecs and gates.
Property tests parameterized off the registry must enforce coverage: collection fails if any field handled by inbound_differ/apply_inbound_records lacks a registry entry.
Property tests must verify roundtrip identity only for declared-bidirectional codecs, add-wins idempotence for merge fields, and gate consultation for one-way-gated fields through real call paths.
Documentation must record the field contract as a cross-cutting registration convention so future reconciler fields are declared durably and new call sites know the contract.
